writeup: TIC 237505178 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 5.1865 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse causing 3.50% dimming and a secondary eclipse detected at 5.9 sigma significance. The Box Least Squares detection signal reaches 77.6, and pixel-level analysis using difference imaging confirms a peak signal-to-noise of 14.5, though with a centroid offset of 2.5 arcsec from the target coordinates. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel detection. The machine-learning pipeline assigned it a screening score of 0.37, reflecting moderate confidence that this represents a real eclipsing system rather than an artifact or false positive.
